description: Glassbox: a one-screen session summary after every turn, and a loop guard before every tool call. Plugin options: `feedback` hands new findings back to the agent once each; `context` keeps a memory in <project>/.glassbox/ and writes the lessons that keep coming back into the agent's own memory (auto memory's MEMORY.md, else CLAUDE.local.md) — or, with `memory` set to glassbox, hands the next session 0.11's note; `guard` (on by default) blocks a shell command that already failed twice in a row, unchanged, this turn — Bash and PowerShell only, so reads and edits never wait on a Node start.
